title: Mirror Partner Dribble
description: Partners face each other, both dribbling; the leader makes moves and the follower copies them instantly, which keeps both heads up.

content.objective: Copy a partner's dribble moves in real time, forcing the eyes to stay on the partner rather than on the ball.
content.setup: Partners face each other two metres apart, each with a ball.
content.organization: Pairs anywhere on the court; switch leader every 30 seconds.
instructions: The leader dribbles in place and changes height, hand or move.
The follower copies each change as quickly as possible, as a mirror image.
The leader adds simple moves: crossover, between the legs, a step forward or back.
After 30 seconds, the follower becomes the leader.
Final round: the leader moves around the court and the follower shadows them.
coachingPoints: Watch the partner's chest and hands, not your own ball.
Copy instantly; the delay is what you are training out.
commonMistakes: Looking down to check the ball before copying.
Leader making moves too hard for the follower to see.
content.safety: Pairs stay two metres apart and keep moving rounds at a walk or jog.
progressions: Leader moves around the court; follower keeps the two-metre gap.
Add a second ball for both partners.
regressions: Leader announces each move out loud.
variations: Leader uses only the weak hand.
successCriteria: Follower matches each change within one dribble.
Neither partner loses the ball in a round.
content.gameApplication: Reading a defender's body while dribbling is the same skill as reading a partner here.
